passages.text: One may not be able to root out anger from the soul, but it is possible to withstand anger. Any one of you may not be able to eradicate malice, but reasoning has force to work with you to prevent you yielding to malice. For reasoning is not an eradicator, but an antagonist of the passions.
passages.note: anger and resentment; not acting on strong feelings

passages.text: Before pleasure is lust; and after pleasure, joy. And before pain is fear; and after pain is sorrow.
